name: Devil's Breath
disable: DC 23 Thievery check to pluck out the taxidermy's gemstone eyes
reset: The Devil's Breath resets automatically after an hour.

items.name: Exhale Smoke
items.text:
Trigger A non-goblin creature approaches within 10 feet of the taxidermy Sandpoint Devil

---

Effect The taxidermy Sandpoint Devil lurches forward, opens its jaws, and emits a blood-curdling howl and a blast of foul-smelling gray smoke. All creatures in a 30-foot cone directed south of the trap (which reaches all the way to the door leading out to the Pit) must attempt a DC 22 Fortitude save save or become Enfeebled 1 for 1 hour (or Enfeebled 2 for 8 hours on a critical failure).

text: The taxidermy monster lurches forward, howls, and exhales a blast of foul-smelling smoke.
